simplewanderers.guide.page.1.title: Simple Wanderers
simplewanderers.guide.page.1: One Village Wanderer per village: a travel-cloaked trader with a leashed horse, a new stock every 3 days, a restock every 1.5 days and goods that follow the village biome. Kill him and a new one comes after 7 days.
simplewanderers.guide.page.2.title: Village Wanderer
simplewanderers.guide.page.2: One travel-cloaked trader per village: a Wandering Trader in an ochre cloak and a hat with a wide brim.
simplewanderers.guide.page.3.title: Village Wanderer
simplewanderers.guide.page.3: He stays near the village bell, never turns invisible and never despawns. The first visit to a village brings him; killing him is allowed.
simplewanderers.guide.page.4.title: Wanderer's horse
simplewanderers.guide.page.4: A normal horse in an ochre leather armor hangs on the wanderer's leash.
simplewanderers.guide.page.5.title: Wanderer's horse
simplewanderers.guide.page.5: Nobody rides it while it hangs there; sneak and right-click with an empty main hand to take the leash over and keep the horse.
simplewanderers.guide.page.6.title: New stock and restock
simplewanderers.guide.page.6: A fresh set of offers every 3 days and a restock every 1.5 days. The stock is drawn from a seed of village, period and world seed, so every player sees the same offers and a reload never rolls again.
simplewanderers.guide.page.7.title: Goods: wanderer and traveling trader
simplewanderers.guide.page.7: The goods of the Wandering Trader are split. The Village Wanderer sells the everyday part (dyes, seeds, flowers, saplings, sand, logs, buckets);
simplewanderers.guide.page.8.title: Goods: wanderer and traveling trader
simplewanderers.guide.page.8: the traveling trader keeps the exotic part (coral, glow stone, moss, rare saplings, fish buckets). The wanderer sells nothing very rare.
simplewanderers.guide.page.9.title: Biome assortment
simplewanderers.guide.page.9: The wanderer's village type (the Vanilla villager type of the bell's biome) adds two offers from its own pool:
simplewanderers.guide.page.10.title: Biome assortment
simplewanderers.guide.page.10: desert (cactus, sand), savanna (acacia, dry grass), plains (flowers, seeds), taiga (spruce, podzol), snow (spruce, fern, packed ice), jungle (jungle wood, vines) and swamp (lily pad, orchids, mushrooms).
simplewanderers.guide.page.11.title: Settings
simplewanderers.guide.page.11: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simplewanderers.start.title: Welcome to Simple Wanderers
quests.simplewanderers.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simplewanderers.start.welcome.des: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Wanderers Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a lead.
